features.quote: Close to many of the structures are quarried caves

date.basis: not dated; the entry's Rom-Byz? refers to the structures, not the caves

features.quote: These courtyards, resembling pools or enclosures
features.subtype: large straight-walled courtyards resembling pools or enclosures

notes: f2 and f4 are in section '1. The eastern part' of the site; f3 in '2. The western part'. f4 is not called a pool: the entry says the courtyards resemble 'pools or enclosures', so pool_def unclear; they lie south of the eastern courtyard structure and stretch south-west. Springs at the site are water sources, not pools. The Cemetery of Qa'un is a separate site, not in this entry. No graves. Fig. 45 is an aerial photo without arrow or scale, so no plan positions.
